utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send the details and keep you posted on the urgent repairs list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out and help sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still good to bring the tools by this afternoon. What else do you need me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Noah — could you also grab the extension cords and any safety gear you can find? I’ll keep the list organized and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll grab the extension cords and any safety gear I can find. If I spot anything else useful, I’ll bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That late-afternoon window still works for me. I can help cover pickup and coordinate anyone else around 3:30 to 5:00.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you confirm the exact drop-off spot and whether the south block still needs coverage?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — the south block still needs coverage, and we can use the usual drop-off spot by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the date, time, and drop-off spot now, then I’ll check the tools and spare parts we already have.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Hana — once you confirm that, I’ll pass it along and ask around for any extra tools or folks who can help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — I’m checking those details now and I’ll report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve confirmed the north block is covered; I’m checking the remaining spots now and will note which ones still need coverage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks—keep me posted on the open spots, and I can bring my toolbox if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll keep tracking the open spots and let you know which ones still need coverage.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard it’s still drawing a steady crowd. I’m heading by after errands and can drop off some tools, maybe stay for an hour too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful—I’m still piecing the update together, but I’ll pass along anything I hear about what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, just let me know if they’re short on anything else and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Sam — I’m still a little fuzzy on the repair drive, but I’m happy to pitch in. Just remind me what you need, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — I could use help sorting the donated tools and setting up the tables at the community center. Just let me know when you can be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that should work — I can help sort the tools and set up the tables. Just tell me what time to show up, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you help sort donations by the garage? We still need a hand with the tools and boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll round up a few neighbors and bring the word over now. I can also help sort the tools and boxes by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that would help a lot. I’ll meet you by the garage and start sorting the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m heading by later to check on it and see if they still need a hand. If they do, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — that’d be a big help. If you spot any missing tools or spare parts, let me know and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along anything they’re short on. Thanks, Cleo!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep the repair drive details moving and let you know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the plan when it’s set? I’m not taking it as settled until I see it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the repair drive plan once it’s set and circle back with the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Late afternoon still works for me — around 3:30 to 5:00 would be best. Thank you for helping make that fit around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should work, but I’d still like to double-check the route and make sure the tools and spare parts are loaded before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please double-check that — I’d feel better with everything packed before we go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — what’s left, and where do you want me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane — I’m still waiting on the latest list, but I can bring whatever’s needed. Just send me the update when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem — once you’ve got the list, send it my way and I’ll jump in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I’m still planning to stop by after errands and drop off a couple tools. I’ll tell you how the turnout looks once I see it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know which spot you’re dropping off at, and whether anything still needs coverage?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the main table near the community hall entrance, and if they still need coverage, I can stay an hour too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful—I'll check in later and see if they still need an extra pair of hands. Your toolbox would definitely come in handy if they do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—just let me know, and I’ll keep the 3:30 to 5:00 pickup window in mind. I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye—I’ll swing by later and see how they’re doing. If they still need help, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but starting with the community center and the bulletin board by the café sounds right. I’ll pass along the latest as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I probably missed that update too. Just let me know what still needs doing, and I’ll bring the tools this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I’ll send along the update as soon as I get it. If the community center still needs anything after that, you’ll be the first to know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—tell me what still needs sorting, and I’ll take the garage.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll put the repair drive details in your hands and circle back with the plan. We still need tools, a few volunteers, and any spare parts people can donate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll stay by the garage and start sorting the tools, and I’ll keep an eye out for spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still checking the timing and supply list, so let’s confirm the route and loadout before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works for me — I’ll confirm the route and make sure the loadout matches the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that helps. Once you’ve got the route and loadout confirmed, let me know the time and I’ll do one more check before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the date, time, and drop-off spot now, then I’ll report back with the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify them now and let you know as soon as I’ve confirmed everything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — let’s go over the route and do one last check on the supplies before we roll out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll do one last check on the supplies and help make sure we’re set before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Jules—I'll bring my toolbox and we can do a quick final once-over before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good to me — late afternoon around 3:30 to 5:00 would be ideal. Thanks for helping work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — 3:30 to 5:00 works for me, and I’m happy to help with pickup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll help keep track of the supplies and line up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the details and keep my gloves and flashlight ready. Just let me know the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Eli — I’ll pass along the time as soon as it’s set. Thanks for being ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the update when you have it, and I’ll bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the community center and café bulletin board, then send you the updated coverage list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—thanks, Opal. I’ll keep an eye out and be ready to help once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Kira — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and can share the urgent list first. If you have any new repairs or volunteers, send them my way and I’ll add them in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you send me the urgent list first? I just want to confirm what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the urgent list first and keep it updated as things come in. If you spot anything missing, just let me know and I’ll add it right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please — could you send me the list again? I’m happy to help, I just need the details refreshed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’m keeping a running list for the repair drive. I’ll resend the current needs and any updates as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll watch for the list and help with whatever’s still needed.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
